clinic = "Pune"
count = 0
def outer():
    doctor = "Rao"
    def inner():
        patient = "Asha"
        print(patient, doctor, clinic, len("ab"))
    inner()
def bump():
    global count
    count += 1
def make_counter():
    n = 0
    def step():
        nonlocal n
        n += 1
        return n
    return step
outer()
bump()
tick = make_counter()
print(count, tick(), tick())
